• KK Line Doubling Project | Tyada & Shivalingapuram Tunnel Construction Update*
The *Kottavalasa–Kirandul (KK) Line* is one of the most important railway corridors connecting *Kottavalasa in Andhra Pradesh with Kirandul in Chhattisgarh, via Koraput in Odisha.* The railway line plays a crucial role in transporting *iron ore from the Bailadila region to Visakhapatnam & the East Coast ports.*
To increase the capacity of this important corridor, a *new railway line is being constructed parallel to the existing single-line route* as part of the *KK Line Doubling Project.*
